panels.description: Whether this proxy is currently marked active in the database. Inactive proxies are excluded from continuous testing.

targets.rawSql: SELECT active as value FROM proxies WHERE device_id IN ($proxy)

panels.title: Active

panels.description: Computed live: UnstableDaily if downtime > 1h in any 24h window, UnstableHourly if downtime > 10min in any 1h window, otherwise Stable. Unknown when no recent data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE
  WHEN s.total_24h = 0 THEN 0
  WHEN s.failures_24h > 720 THEN 3
  WHEN s.failures_1h > 120 THEN 2
  ELSE 1
END AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN pr.timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND pr.status <> 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures_1h,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pr.timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR AND pr.status <> 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures_24h,
    SUM(CASE WHEN pr.timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_24h
  FROM proxy_requests pr
  WHERE pr.proxy_id IN (${proxy:sqlstring})
) s

panels.title: Stability Status

panels.description: Current rotation classification stored on the proxy. Rotated = IP has changed recently, NoRotation = stuck on same IP for 10+ consecutive checks, Unknown = insufficient data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE COALESCE(MAX(p.rotation_status), 'Unknown')
  WHEN 'Rotated' THEN 2
  WHEN 'NoRotation' THEN 1
  ELSE 0
END AS value
FROM proxies p
WHERE p.device_id IN (${proxy:sqlstring})

panels.title: Rotation Status

panels.description: Total number of IP rotations observed for this proxy since it was added (lifetime, not bound by time picker).

targets.rawSql: SELECT rotation_count AS value FROM proxies WHERE device_id IN ($proxy)

panels.title: Rotation Count

panels.description: Timestamp of the most recent IP rotation. Falls back to the latest recorded rotation event if the proxy's stored value is missing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(p.last_rotation_at)) * 1000,
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(ir.rotation_timestamp)) * 1000
) AS value
FROM proxies p
LEFT JOIN ip_rotations ir ON ir.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE p.device_id IN (${proxy:sqlstring})

panels.title: Last Rotation At

panels.description: Percent of SUCCESS responses among all requests in the selected time range and source filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as value
FROM proxy_requests pr
WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp)
  AND pr.source IN ($source)
  AND pr.proxy_id IN ($proxy)

panels.title: Success Rate

panels.description: Percent of non-SUCCESS responses (timeouts, connection errors, HTTP errors, etc.) in the selected time range and source filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as value
FROM proxy_requests pr
WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp)
  AND pr.source IN ($source)
  AND pr.proxy_id IN ($proxy)

panels.title: Error Rate

panels.description: Mean response time (ms) across all requests in the selected time range. Outliers can skew this; cross-reference with the Response Time Over Time chart.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT AVG(pr.response_time_ms) as value
FROM proxy_requests pr
WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp)
  AND pr.source IN ($source)
  AND pr.proxy_id IN ($proxy)

panels.title: Average Response Time

panels.description: Count of all requests issued against this proxy in the selected time range and source filter.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as value
FROM proxy_requests pr
WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp)
  AND pr.source IN ($source)
  AND pr.proxy_id IN ($proxy)

panels.title: Total Requests

panels.description: Percent of periodic_rotation requests that failed (non-SUCCESS) in the selected time range. Returns 0 when no rotation traffic exists.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(
  ROUND(
    COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.status != 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ),
  0
) as value
FROM proxy_requests pr
WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp)
  AND pr.source = 'periodic_rotation'
  AND pr.source IN ($source)
  AND pr.proxy_id IN (${proxy:sqlstring})

panels.title: Rotation Test Failure Rate

panels.description: Percent of rotations where the outbound IP did not actually change (ip_after = ip_before or null). High values indicate rotation isn't producing new IPs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(
  COUNT(CASE WHEN ir.ip_after IS NULL OR ir.ip_after = ir.ip_before THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
  2
) as value
FROM ip_rotations ir
WHERE $__timeFilter(ir.rotation_timestamp)
  AND ir.proxy_id IN ($proxy)

panels.title: Rotation IP No-Change Rate

panels.description: Most recent updated_at timestamp on the proxy record, or the latest request timestamp if proxy hasn't been updated.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(p.updated_at)) * 1000,
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(pr.timestamp)) * 1000
) AS value
FROM proxies p
LEFT JOIN proxy_requests pr ON pr.proxy_id = p.device_id
WHERE p.device_id IN (${proxy:sqlstring})

panels.title: Last Updated At

panels.description: Firmware/agent version reported by the proxy device on its last sync.

targets.rawSql: SELECT version as value FROM proxies WHERE device_id IN ($proxy)

panels.title: Version

panels.description: Average response time (ms) bucketed by minute. Spikes indicate latency degradation; sustained increases suggest backend or network issues.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(pr.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec,
  AVG(pr.response_time_ms) as avg_response_time
FROM proxy_requests pr
WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp)
  AND pr.source IN ($source)
  AND pr.proxy_id IN ($proxy)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.title: Response Time Over Time

panels.description: Per-minute success rate (% of SUCCESS responses) for this proxy. Drops below 100% pinpoint when failure events occurred.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(pr.timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN pr.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as success_rate
FROM proxy_requests pr
WHERE $__timeFilter(pr.timestamp)
  AND pr.source IN ($source)
  AND pr.proxy_id IN ($proxy)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.title: Success Rate Over Time

panels.description: Per-minute trend of failed rotation attempts. Use to detect rotation outages or systemic failures.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(ir.rotation_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ir.success = false THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) as test_failure_rate
FROM ip_rotations ir
WHERE $__timeFilter(ir.rotation_timestamp)
  AND ir.proxy_id IN ($proxy)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.title: Rotation Test Failure Rate Over Time

panels.description: Per-minute trend of rotations where the IP did not change. Distinguishes 'rotation succeeded but produced same IP' from outright rotation failures.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(DATE_FORMAT(ir.rotation_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00')) as time_sec,
  ROUND(
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ir.ip_after IS NULL OR ir.ip_after = ir.ip_before THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) as ip_no_change_rate
FROM ip_rotations ir
WHERE $__timeFilter(ir.rotation_timestamp)
  AND ir.proxy_id IN ($proxy)
GROUP BY time_sec
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.title: Rotation IP No-Change Rate Over Time

panels.description: Breakdown of non-SUCCESS errors by error_type (TIMEOUT, CONNECTION_ERROR, HTTP_ERROR, DNS_ERROR, OTHER). Identifies the dominant failure class for this proxy.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(pr.error_type, 'UNKNOWN') AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM proxy_requests pr
WHERE pr.timestamp >= FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom())
  AND pr.timestamp <= FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo())
  AND pr.proxy_id IN ($proxy)
  AND pr.source IN ($source)
  AND pr.status <> 'SUCCESS'
GROUP BY COALESCE(pr.error_type, 'UNKNOWN')
ORDER BY value DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Error Type Distribution

panels.description: Per-rotation row (periodic type only): timestamp, IP before, IP after, success flag, duration, retry count, error message.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(ir.rotation_timestamp, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS cycle_time,
  ir.rotation_type AS cycle_type,
  ir.ip_before,
  ir.ip_after,
  ir.success,
  ir.rotation_duration_ms,
  ir.retry_count,
  ir.error_message
FROM ip_rotations ir
WHERE ir.rotation_timestamp >= FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom())
  AND ir.rotation_timestamp <= FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo())
  AND ir.proxy_id IN ($proxy)
  AND ir.rotation_type = 'periodic'
ORDER BY ir.rotation_timestamp DESC
LIMIT $limit

panels.title: Rotation Cycle Summary (Periodic)

panels.description: Most recent individual request rows for this proxy (timestamp, status, response time, error info, outbound IP, IP-change flag, source). Drill-down for triage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  pr.timestamp,
  pr.status,
  pr.response_time_ms,
  pr.error_type,
  pr.error_message,
  pr.outbound_ip,
  pr.ip_changed,
  pr.source
FROM proxy_requests pr
WHERE pr.timestamp >= FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom())
  AND pr.timestamp <= FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo())
  AND pr.proxy_id IN ($proxy)
  AND pr.source IN ($source)
ORDER BY pr.timestamp DESC
LIMIT $limit

panels.title: Recent Requests (Per Proxy)

panels.description: Proxies with rotation_count = 0 and no last_rotation_at value. These have never produced an observed IP rotation since registration.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.device_id,
  p.name,
  p.location,
  p.rotation_status,
  p.last_rotation_at,
  p.rotation_count,
  p.last_ip,
  p.version,
  p.updated_at
FROM proxies p
WHERE p.rotation_count = 0
  AND p.last_rotation_at IS NULL
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC
LIMIT $limit

panels.title: Never Rotated Proxies (Tester)

panels.description: Earliest request timestamp ever recorded for this proxy (lifetime, not bound by time picker).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(`timestamp`)) * 1000 as value
FROM proxy_requests
WHERE proxy_id IN (${proxy:sqlstring})

panels.title: First Seen

panels.description: Most recent request timestamp ever recorded for this proxy (lifetime, not bound by time picker).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(`timestamp`)) * 1000 as value
FROM proxy_requests
WHERE proxy_id IN (${proxy:sqlstring})

panels.title: Last Seen

panels.description: Total distinct calendar days on which this proxy issued at least one request (lifetime).

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT DATE(timestamp)) as value FROM proxy_requests WHERE proxy_id IN ($proxy)

panels.title: Active Days (total)

panels.description: Request count per 5-minute window. Gaps where count drops to zero indicate inactivity periods.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`timestamp`) / 300) * 300 AS time_sec,
  COUNT(*) AS requests
FROM proxy_requests
WHERE `timestamp` >= FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochFrom())
  AND `timestamp` <= FROM_UNIXTIME($__unixEpochTo())
  AND proxy_id IN ($proxy)
GROUP BY FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(`timestamp`) / 300) * 300
ORDER BY time_sec

panels.title: Activity Timeline (requests per 5-min bucket)

list.definition: SELECT CONCAT(device_id, ' - ', name) as __text, device_id as __value FROM proxies WHERE name IS NOT NULL
list.name: proxy
list.query: SELECT CONCAT(device_id, ' - ', name) as __text, device_id as __value FROM proxies WHERE name IS NOT NULL
